hotforteacher.bpmNote: The tab is written in cut time (half note = 128); the record is 128 BPM, so Pulse shows 128 and plays the tab at its written speed.

heaviestmatter.bpmNote: The tab counts the double-time pulse (about 207); the record is listed at 103, so Pulse shows half and plays the tab at its written speed.

singsing.bpmNote: The tab counts double (about 220 in the main groove); the 1937 record is listed at about 112, so Pulse shows half and plays the tab at its written speed.
singsing.confidence: transcribed (Songsterr community tab); excerpt: about 3 minutes of the 8:43 1937 recording

songforthedead.bpmNote: Main groove about 106 (record listed at 107); the fast intro runs about 205–214 as written in the tab.

holdtheline.bpmNote: The tab counts dotted quarters in 12/8 (97, matching the record); Pulse plays it at that pulse.

africa.bpmNote: The tab is in cut time (half note = 92, matching the record at about 92); Pulse shows 92 and plays it as written.

shookme.bpmNote: Intro about 120, main groove about 130 (record listed around 127–128).

lengthCheck.source: Wikipedia track length (In the Jungle Groove: "Funky Drummer (Bonus Beat Reprise)", 2:54; the full 1970 single edit is 9:13)

funkydrummer.confidence: transcribed (Songsterr community tab); this is the Bonus Beat Reprise (2:54), not the full 9:13 track

aenema.bpmNote: The tab counts dotted quarters (about 122 in the 12/8 intro, about 60 in the 6/8 sections written at half speed); Pulse shows the dotted-quarter pulse.

cobham.confidence: transcribed (Songsterr community tab); excerpt: about 2:45 of a much longer track

meetingspirits.confidence: transcribed (Songsterr community tab); approximate: 13% shorter than the record, and the tab notes some bars were duplicated

mitchell.bpmNote: About 150 BPM on the record (AcousticBrainz median of 156 analyses, via TempoPeek); the tab’s 147 was scaled to 150.

bitesdust.bpmNote: About 110 BPM on the record (AcousticBrainz median of 624 analyses, via TempoPeek); the tab’s 112 was scaled to 110, which also matches the track length.
